note: Health now reports error whenever a second upload waits behind a running conversion, so the API monitor goes down with database and cache fine; no runbook section covers this new check.

cause.title: feat: report a stuck conversion queue in the health check
cause.author: Philipp Klinger
cause.patch:
diff --git a/core/health.py b/core/health.py
@@ -6,6 +6,8 @@ import logging
 from django.conf import settings
 from django.core.cache import cache
 from django.db import connection
+from django_rq import get_queue
+from rq import Worker
 from rest_framework import status, views
 from rest_framework.permissions import AllowAny
 from rest_framework.response import Response
@@ -26,7 +28,11 @@ class HealthView(views.APIView):
     throttle_classes = []
 
     def get(self, request):
-        checks = {"database": _check_database(), "cache": _check_cache()}
+        checks = {
+            "database": _check_database(),
+            "cache": _check_cache(),
+            "queue": _check_queue(),
+        }
         healthy = all(result == "ok" for result in checks.values())
         body = {"status": "ok" if healthy else "error", **checks}
         code = status.HTTP_200_OK if healthy else status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
@@ -66,3 +72,16 @@ def _check_cache():
     except Exception:
         logger.exception("Health check: cache not reachable")
         return "error"
+
+
+def _check_queue():
+    # Jobs waiting while no worker is idle means the conversion queue does not move.
+    try:
+        queue = get_queue("default")
+        if queue.count and not any(w.get_state() == "idle" for w in Worker.all(queue=queue)):
+            logger.error("Health check: %s conversions waiting, no idle worker", queue.count)
+            return "error"
+        return "ok"
+    except Exception:
+        logger.exception("Health check: queue not readable")
+        return "error"
cause.body:
Uploads waited silently when the worker hung. The health check now reports
the queue as error when jobs are waiting and no worker is idle, so Kuma
alerts on a stuck queue as well.
